listing.summary: Firstlevelplays; later parts of the game have not been played;installation on a clean machine has not been tested. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own Xbox 360 PAL ISO or extracted folder. The documented disc editions are English/German and Spanish/Italian; the title ID is not recorded here. Accepted default.xex fingerprints are 02ff6672d460c9aaa54e69d584af67a7138c6c93cde5e04b0da4284207be7c61 and 02846647633e93c627e74b92d3ad63a90e1504546958fc8d81e28ac65de1f9bc.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use the release installer and import your own ISO. Games run as standalone native programs. The CoreOfLight hub and a real USB portal are optional; a virtual portal is supported. The Windows x64 player uses D3D12. Building from source requires VS2022 Clang, CMake, Ninja, just and Python.
